record.title: Check a bounded binary receive core with supplied readers
record.intent: Remove line-delimited collection from the next readout proposal without contacting an instrument.
requirements: Bind the sealed supplied-byte oracle, primary guide and recovered stock profile. Work in a fresh ignored root only; preserve previous seals, public parsers, reducers and original measurements.

Compose a strongly typed binary receive core with injected named read-demand and read-result abstractions only. No actual socket, SSH, ADB, serial, guest, physical controller, helper or endpoint backend is part of this task.

Require explicit expected count, recovered header profile, suffix policy and deadline. Consume by declared byte lengths rather than line delimiters; retain exact partial bytes and demand/result records on success, EOF, failure, overdelivery, deadline or framing rejection. Stop without replay or an ambiguous retry.

Independently verify meaningful arbitrary-fragmentation, embedded LF/NUL, malformed header, payload/count bounds, suffix, timeout, EOF, failure and partial-preservation controls. Explicit supplied time and suffix do not establish physical timing or actual device grammar.

Preserve the exact remaining physical binary suffix and coefficient-prediction boundaries. A pure supplied-reader control is not a ready physical collector or stock execution. Stop and checkpoint before the current hard deadline at 2026-10-02T23:05:20Z even if a supported incomplete preparation is the result.
acceptance: An independently checked supplied-reader core or exact unresolved preparation boundary is durable.
